name: Alamia Accounts Copilot Knowledgebase Manifest
description: Semantic catalog mapping user conversational intents to accounting rules, documentation chapters, database tables, and API routes.

intents.summary: Explains that folder/category accounts (category: true) are for grouping only and cannot accept transactions. Only leaf accounts (category: false) accept journal entries.

validation_rules: Total debits must equal total credits
Every detail account must have category=false

intents.summary: Create company-specific custom voucher templates with dynamic fields, validation formulas, and automatic double-entry journal rule mappings.
Every company has an isolated ledger partition. Accounts inherit from the standard template; journal vouchers and balances are strictly segregated by domainUuid.
Natural language inquiry and search across vouchers, accounts, and contacts with automatic double-entry briefing, card formatting, and multi-match disambiguation.
Real-time developer telemetry capturing prompts, classifier decisions, latency, safety evaluations, and responses with full JSONL/CSV dataset export for AI evaluation.
Database-driven dynamic knowledgebase allowing developers and domain experts to train Copilot with custom workflows, trigger phrases, and operational steps without code deployment.

database_entities.ledger_domains: Tenants and branches (code, name, currency, extra)
database_entities.ledger_accounts: Global account chart (code, category, debit, credit, parentUuid)
database_entities.domain_ledger_accounts: Pivot linking accounts to specific company domains
database_entities.journal_entries: Header for double-entry transactions (transDate, currency, reference)
database_entities.journal_details: Debit/credit line items per account (ledgerUuid, amount, balanceSide)
database_entities.domain_journal_entries: Pivot scoping every transaction to a specific domainUuid
database_entities.copilot_diagnostic_logs: Developer telemetry capturing turn prompt, classifier mode, intent, confidence, duration, context state, and output payload
database_entities.copilot_knowledge_entries: Self-learned dynamic ERP guidance rules containing trigger keywords, operational steps, compliance notes, and deep-link actions
database_entities.custom_voucher_types: Definitions for user-built dynamic voucher templates
database_entities.custom_voucher_fields: Form fields with data types and validation formulas
database_entities.custom_voucher_account_rules: Mapping rules that generate double-entry lines from form fields
